description: This Java class 'DesCrypt' provides utility methods for 3DES (Triple DES) encryption and decryption, including key generation, encryption, decryption, and key specification handling.

classes.name: DesCrypt
classes.description: Utility class for performing 3DES encryption, decryption, key generation, and key specification.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts data using a provided key, prepending an IV for decryption.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts data using a provided key, extracting the IV from the encrypted payload.

methods.name: getDesKey
methods.description: Creates a SecretKey object from a raw byte array representing a 3DES key.

methods.name: getCipher
methods.description: Creates and initializes a Cipher instance for 3DES with CBC mode and PKCS5 padding.
